fitting: Firth logistic regression, refit before every fight using strictly earlier eligible decisive outcomes at all confidence levels, including earlier outcomes on the same card.
prior_interpretation: No hand-set fighter probability or Beta prior. Firth/Jeffreys penalty supplies bias reduction; forecasts are fitted point estimates, not posterior-integrated probabilities.
fee_approximation: ask + 0.07*ask*(1-ask), continuous approximation as used in saved simulations
verification: Recomputed Kelly fractions from saved probabilities and ledger costs; both match saved drawdown attribution within floating-point precision. Training counts reconstructed from the exact earlier-row eligibility rule. No new probability fit was performed.
limitations: These two purchase quotes are recovered historical pre-card quotes, not verified executable quotes at each sequential fight start.
Most earlier training prices are reconstructed; price reconstruction used retrospective quote pairs.
Firth bias reduction is not a validation of probability calibration, and the model imposes a single linear confidence effect on log odds.
Portfolio selection was retrospective. Sizing used probability point estimates without an additional calibration discount or an exposure cap in the full-Kelly case.
